free_resources.title: Inner Peace Meditations
free_resources.description: Steven's free library of more than a hundred short guided meditations, most around ten minutes, sorted by need: busy minds, stress, sleep, self-compassion and more. Taught from his own life with tetraplegia, in plain words.

free_resources.title: Stillness in the Storms Podcast
free_resources.description: A free podcast of short, honest talks on meeting anger, grief, worry, pain and tiredness with meditation and Buddhist-inspired wisdom, each episode labelled with its length and theme.

free_resources.title: Stressed to Calm in 5 Minutes
free_resources.description: A very short seated practice with wave sounds: arms up on a big breath, two slow deep breaths, then letting the breath find its own rhythm. Made for the moments just before something you are tense about.

flags: The podcast has an early episode titled 'How 5 Minutes Meditation Can Help with Depression' (stillnessinthestorms.com/episode/9-...); not opened. The podcast as a whole is wellbeing talk, so it is listed; a human may want to check that one episode.
'Stressed to Calm in 5 Minutes' is one episode of Inner Peace Meditations, so both the library and the episode are listed (different URLs).
